title: Reliable commerce execution for personal agents
excerpt: One API for your personal agent to search, build a basket and check out at real stores, with spending limits, vaulted credentials and a virtual card per agent.
content_html:
One unified API for discovery, checkout and fulfilment across hundreds of merchants.

Sign up

Book a call

Transact reliably across merchant stores your users love and trust

Need a store that isn't here? Request a merchant

One API from your agent to the merchant.

  1. 01

    Your agents call one API

    Every user's agent searches, builds baskets and checks out over REST or MCP.

  2. 02

    Every purchase is approved

    Approval binds to the exact basket and a spending ceiling.

  3. 03

    Credentials stay in the vault

    Merchant logins and the customer profile are used at checkout and never reach the model.

  4. 04

    One commit per approval

    The checkout runtime places the order once. An uncertain submission is reconciled, never retried blind.

  5. 05

    The receipt comes back

    Order confirmation and totals return to your agent.

Search, basket, checkout.

One API, from the first search to the order receipt.

Reorder by text

Your shopper asks in plain words. Your agent finds the items, builds the basket and checks out.

Search a real catalog

Live prices and stock from each store, every result ready for the cart.

Approve the exact basket

Checkout is bound to the reviewed items and total.

Sign-in codes, handed off

When a store asks for a code, your agent asks your shopper.

Follow the order

Status comes back after checkout.

MCP or REST

Plug in the agent you already use, or call the API from your own backend.

MCP for coding and chat agents

RESTapi.getagentmall.com for your backend

Browser agents are the wrong tool for checkout.

A model that decides every click sounds general-purpose. At checkout, general-purpose fails in ways you can't afford.

You build the agent.

We handle the messy maintenance underneath.

  • Merchant-specific checkout

    Every merchant has its own monitored flow, so your agent gets through where generic browser automation is blocked.

  • Credentials in a vault

    Use our managed vault, or bring your own, such as 1Password. Logins never reach the model.

  • A virtual card per agent

    Your users never hand their own card to an agent.

  • Spending limits

    Approval binds to the exact basket and a spending ceiling.

  • No double charges

    An uncertain order is checked with the merchant before anything is tried again.

  • Affiliate revenue

    Earn on every order your agent places, with no extra integration.

Let's make your agent reliable, fast, trusted and profitable.

Sign up
